entries.note: DOI -> PMID 18780814 (Neuro Oncol 11(2):158-66, epub 2008-09, print 2009). Quote verbatim in abstract. No patient engagement readout in any cited trial; untested holds. MONDO:0018177 = glioblastoma (OLS).

DOI -> PMID 18301895 (Cancer Chemother Pharmacol 62(6):1045-54, 2008). Clause verbatim in abstract. Abstract: rat A15 glioma was subcutaneous, brain retention is normal brain; model string 'rats bearing glioma' over-implies intracranial tumour PK.

Abstract states preclinical BBB-crossing premise (species unnamed, no rodent ratio) and 30x verbatim; it does not put model and patient side by side, so comparison_stated=true is unconfirmed (Karger paywalled, ZORA blocked). No exposure target existed: direction-only tumour retention in BBB-disrupted re-resection tissue, one drug, n=9. If the brief requires a target or an explicit in-source comparison, this is untested.
Same Hoffmann 2009 record; quote verbatim in abstract; untested holds as the strip opener (print 2009, epub 2008).

PMC3164435 full text read. Discussion sentence is 51 words; elided clause = 'a favorable pharmacokinetic profile of a lipophylic agent with penetration across the blood-brain barrier and tolerable toxicity allowing for delivery of adequate doses' (refs). Elision does not change meaning; it only drops PK/tox items, strengthening attribution of the miss to the efficacy model. Intro cites near-complete prevention of orthotopic U373/U87 growth, so comparison_stated=true holds. No objective responses, PFS6 6.7% confirmed. NCT00424060 has no posted results (confirmed).

DOI -> PMID 27540016, quote verbatim in abstract. The reset to untested is not permitted: the brief's override rule makes contra dominate every matched status, so a model switch with no new comparison cannot clear it (a same could not, so untested must not). The 'new' model is the same system (orthotopic GBM xenograft, nude mice) refined with PDX cells and an EB1 biomarker. Keep contra from 2011 through 2025; record the model switch as a note on a contra-status entry.

PMC12208313 full text: 'Our experience in this study did not confirm EB1 as a reliable predictor of response to lisavanbulin.' verbatim. 1 PR/9 EB1+ evaluable, study closed, 3 durable responders/37 relapsed brain-tumour patients confirmed. Intro attributes the EB1 prediction to the orthotopic GBM6 model, so contra on the model's biomarker prediction holds. Nuance: phase 2a EB1 selection was also motivated by two retrospectively EB1+ phase-1 responders. NCT02490800 resultsFirstPostDate 2024-06-26 confirmed (CT.gov API).

missing: engagement: Oehler 2012 (doi:10.1159/000339152) analysed patupilone-exposed re-resection tissue (MeSH Apoptosis, Ki-67, Tubulin). If the full text compares exposed vs pre-treatment tissue (apoptosis/mitotic index), that is a patient engagement readout for the class; the draft's claim that it was response-predictive only is unverified at abstract level. Needs the full text.

safety: cell is empty with no stated reason. Peripheral neuropathy is the class toxicity in patients (Stupp 2011 Table: 46% any grade; Oehler 2012: grade <=3 in 2/9). I found no published animal prediction either, so empty is permissible, but the draft should say so in note/judgement.
All six DOIs cited only in judgement fields (Burgenske 2022, Chamberlain 2014, Grossmann 2012, Silvani 2009, Joerger 2023, Sirisoma 2009) resolve on PubMed; not read.
rule_questions: Model succession: the brief has no rule for a mid-strip model switch. The override rule ('contra overrides every matched status') implies contra persists until a published comparison for the context, and a reset to untested would let a new model escape a contra that a same could not. Decide explicitly whether a refinement of the same system (cell-line xenograft -> PDX + biomarker) is ever a 'new model' and, if so, whether its first entry is untested or inherits the context's contra.

Dose cell with no numeric target: the rodent PK model (O'Reilly 2008) predicted only qualitative retention in tumour/brain. Does a direction-only agreement (tumour 30x plasma, BBB-disrupted recurrent tissue, n=9, one drug) satisfy 'the model's exposure/occupancy target held', and does an abstract that states the preclinical premise and the patient measurement without an explicit side-by-side count as a source that 'makes the comparison'? Strict reading -> untested; the draft's same rests on the lenient reading.

Attribution when a prospective biomarker cohort is motivated by both the model and a clinical retrospective finding (Lopez 2025: EB1 from the GBM6 model and from two EB1+ phase-1 responders): is the failed enrichment scored against the model? The draft says yes; the brief does not say.
